verdict.rationale: Anthropic's docs say Claude loads skills automatically when they are relevant to the task, the spec requires descriptions that state what a skill does and when to use it, and skill-creator offers to optimize a description for triggering accuracy. Hands-on community reports contradict this concretely: several users say skills are not triggered by expected keywords and must be invoked explicitly, and Vercel's evals found the skill was never invoked in 56% of cases. missing for 10: independent evidence that automatic triggering works reliably in practice, quantitative first-party data on triggering accuracy.

support.subject: As a developer, installed skills trigger automatically from task context, with descriptions engineered so the agent activates the right skill at the right moment

citations.quote: Claude uses skills when relevant, or you can invoke one directly with `/skill-name`.
If Claude thinks the skill is relevant to the current task, it will load the skill by reading its full `SKILL.md` into context.
Should describe both what the skill does and when to use it
optimize a skill's description for better triggering accuracy.
the skill was never invoked in 56% of cases, and adding it gave no improvement over baseline.
